recipe.title: Easy Banana Bread
recipe.instructions: Preheat oven to 350F. Mix melted butter with bananas in a bowl. Stir in sugar, egg, and vanilla. Mix in baking soda and salt. Add flour and mix until just combined. Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake for 50-55 minutes.

data.title: Easy Banana Bread
data.instructions: Preheat oven to 350F. Mix melted butter with bananas in a bowl. Stir in sugar, egg, and vanilla. Mix in baking soda and salt. Add flour and mix until just combined. Pour into a greased loaf pan and bake for 50-55 minutes.
